name: Who’s Coming
intro:
⚠️ BEFORE STEP 1 — check you are in a test copy. Look for the small “🧪 Test copy” mark on the screen. It means this app has never seen you, which is what the steps below expect. If it is missing and the app already shows your own information, you have opened your real app: go back to your list and tap this app's name again, rather than using a bookmark, your history, or an icon on your home screen. Starting in the wrong copy makes the early steps look broken when nothing is wrong.

You will make a small group, ask it one question and record the answers yourself, all on this phone. Nothing is sent to anyone: the people you add have no phone numbers, so the app only copies the message for you.

steps.do: A white card at the bottom says “Welcome to Who’s Coming”. Tap the small words “skip the tour” in its bottom-right corner.
steps.see: The card now asks “How do you want to start?” with “🧪 Keep the examples to play with” and “✨ Start fresh with my own”.
steps.tip: A “Step 1 of 3 — your name and mobile number” card may show at the top: you can fill it or skip it for this test.

steps.do: Tap “✨ Start fresh with my own”.
steps.see: A small question box asks “Start fresh? The examples will be cleared.” with Cancel and OK.

steps.do: Tap “OK”.
steps.see: After a moment (2–4 seconds) a card says “Good morning. What would you like to do?” (or afternoon/evening) with “❓ Ask the family something”, “✅ See who has answered” and “👥 My groups and people”.

steps.do: Tap “👥 My groups and people”.
steps.see: The People page opens, with a “New group” box and an “Add group” button.

steps.do: If a card “Keep Who’s Coming on your Home Screen” pops up (iPhone only), tap “Later”. If no card appears, go to the next step.
steps.see: The card goes away.

steps.do: Leave the “Group name” box empty and tap “Add group”.
steps.see: Nothing happens — no empty group is made.

steps.do: Tap the “Group name” box, type the name below, then tap “Add group”.
steps.see: A new card “Sunday lunch crew” appears at the top with “Nobody in it yet.” and boxes for a Name and Mobile (optional).

steps.do: In that card, tap the “Name” box, type this name (keep the apostrophe), leave Mobile empty, and tap “Add”.
steps.see: Margaret O'Brien is listed, spelled right, with “no number — copy & paste to send” under her name.

steps.do: Do the same for one more person: type the name below in the “Name” box and tap “Add”.
steps.see: Pastor Dan is listed under Margaret O'Brien, also with “no number — copy & paste to send”.

steps.do: Tap the round “?” button near the bottom-right corner (not the red ❓ Asks tab at the very bottom). If you don’t see a round ?, hold your phone upright — on a wide screen or a computer it is not there yet; then tap 🤷 and skip to step 12.
steps.see: A “Help and settings” panel slides up. One of its choices is “🏠 Start menu: what would you like to do?”.

steps.do: Tap “🏠 Start menu: what would you like to do?”.
steps.see: The “Good morning. What would you like to do?” card comes back.

steps.do: Tap “❓ Ask the family something”.
steps.see: An “Ask something” form: “Who are you asking?” already says “Sunday lunch crew (2)”, and “Yes / No / Maybe” is the answer type.

steps.do: Tap the question box, type the question below, then tap “Save and send →”.
steps.type: Sunday lunch at Margaret's, 1pm — who's coming?
steps.see: A box slides up from the bottom: “Your name first”, with a “Your first name” box.

steps.do: Type your first name as below, then press the blue return / Go key on the keyboard.
steps.see: A message box says “No mobile numbers on this group yet — the message is copied. Paste it into your group text, or add numbers under People.” Nothing was sent.
steps.tip: You can use the keyboard’s return key or the “Send it” button.

steps.do: Tap “OK” on that message.
steps.see: Your question card shows “Sunday lunch at Margaret's, 1pm — who's coming?”, “Sunday lunch crew · 0 of 2 answered”, three zeros (Yes, No, Maybe), and “not yet” under each person.

steps.do: Under Margaret O'Brien, tap “Yes”.
steps.see: Margaret’s “Yes” button turns green, the Yes count goes to 1, the line says “1 of 2 answered”, and under Margaret it says “Yes ·” with today’s date.

steps.do: Tap “📋 Copy the tally”.
steps.see: A short note says “Copied — paste it anywhere”. (If you like, paste it into Notes: it lists Margaret O'Brien: Yes and Pastor Dan: —.)

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: The question is still there with “1 of 2 answered” and Margaret’s Yes.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Then under Pastor Dan, tap “Maybe”.
steps.see: A yellow strip says “No connection right now — the app still works and saves on this phone.” The card now says “2 of 2 answered”, Maybe shows 1, and the “Nudge the quiet ones” button is gone because everyone has answered.

steps.do: Turn Airplane Mode off and scroll back to the top.
steps.see: Your question “Sunday lunch at Margaret's, 1pm — who's coming?” is at the top with “2 of 2 answered”: Margaret O'Brien said Yes and Pastor Dan said Maybe.

steps.do: Scroll to the question card and tap “📤 Send the summary”.
steps.see: A box opens headed “Send the summary” with three choices: “To everyone in the group (2)”, “Only the ones coming (…)” and “💬 WhatsApp — you pick the chat”.
steps.tip: Nothing is sent by tapping these — your own Messages or WhatsApp opens with the words ready, and you would still have to press send. Close the box with Cancel when you have looked.

steps.do: Tap “Cancel” to close that box. Now tap “💬 WhatsApp” next to “📨 Text the group”.
steps.see: WhatsApp opens (or asks to open) with the question already typed in, ready for you to choose a chat. Do NOT send it — come straight back to the app.
steps.tip: If WhatsApp is not on this phone, you may see a web page instead, or nothing at all. Either is fine — write down what happened.

steps.do: Back in the app, tap “＋ Ask the group something”, choose your group, and type: Bring a dish on Sunday?  Then in the box “If they say yes, also ask them…” type: What are you bringing?
steps.see: The second box is there under the Yes / No / Maybe choices, with grey words under it saying only the people who say yes will see it.
steps.tip: Tap “Pick one” and then “In their own words” and watch that box: it should stay for “Pick one” and disappear for “In their own words”.

steps.do: Set it back to “Yes / No / Maybe”, then tap “Save and send →”, and on the message that opens tap OK or Cancel without sending.
steps.see: The new question is at the top of the list with your follow-up saved on it.

steps.do: Under one person's name on the NEW question, tap “Yes”. Then tap the “💬 Add” button that appears beside their answer.
steps.see: A box opens headed “What are you bringing?” — your own follow-up question, not “Why can’t they come?”.
steps.tip: That same button says “💬 Why?” for somebody who answered No. Both are optional.

steps.do: Type: A pudding  — then tap “Save”.
steps.see: Beside that person's name it now reads Yes and “A pudding” in quote marks.

steps.do: Tap “📋 Copy the tally” on that question, then paste it somewhere you can read it (a new note, or the box the app shows you).
steps.see: The line for that person reads their name, then “Yes (A pudding)”.
steps.tip: If the phone will not let the app copy, it shows you the words to copy by hand — that is expected, not a fault.

steps.do: Scroll right to the bottom of the page.
steps.see: The last line says “Who’s Coming v1.17 · 2026-11-06 …” and under it a green link “See the other Daraja apps ›”. Tap it.
steps.tip: It should open the Daraja store. Come back afterwards. If the version does not say v1.17, say so — you may be on an old copy.
